findings.oracle: Drives the real WindowsSandbox._generate_wsb_config consumer with a SandboxConfig whose shared folder guest path contains reserved XML chars (C:\Sand "<box>" & Co); independent oracle is the XML spec escaping rule (< -> <, > -> >, & -> &) plus the original input string; asserts the serialized bytes contain <box> and & Co, that no raw <box> leaks into element text, and that a hardened defusedxml reparse recovers the exact original unescaped guest path.
